description_en: Queries the cross-region forwarding mode of an Express Connect Router (ECR)
description_zh: 查询专线网关ECR（Express Connect Router）的跨地域转发模式
name: DescribeExpressConnectRouterInterRegionTransitMode

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the Express Connect Router (ECR)
parameters.name: ecr_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform only a dry run on the request. Valid values:

true: performs a dry run and does not modify the EPS resource.

false: sends a normal request. This is the default value
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会修改服务资源。

false（默认值）：发送正常请求
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can generate the parameter value from your client to ensure that the value is unique across different requests. The ClientToken parameter supports only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each API request is different
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: The details about the access denial

Code.description_en: Indicates whether the call was successful. A return value of 200 indicates success, and any other value indicates failure. For the cause of failure, see error codes
Code.description_zh: 判断调用是否成功。返回值为200表示加载成功，返回其他值表示加载失败，失败原因参见错误码

DynamicMessage.description_en:
The dynamic error message, which is used to replace `%s` in the ErrMessage response parameter.
If ErrMessage returns The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid and DynamicMessage returns DtsJobId, it indicates that the DtsJobId request parameter is invalid
DynamicMessage.description_zh:
动态错误信息，用于替换返回参数ErrMessage错误信息中的`%s`。
如果ErrMessage返回The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid，且DynamicMessage返回DtsJobId，则代表所传入的请求参数DtsJobId不合法
DynamicMessage.example: The param format of EcrId **** is illegal.

InterRegionTransitModeList.description_en: The list of cross-region forwarding modes

Mode.description_en:
The cross-region forwarding mode of the ECR. Valid values:
ECMP: load balancing mode.
NearBy: nearest forwarding mode
Mode.description_zh:
ECR跨域转发模式，取值：
ECMP：负载均衡模式。
NearBy：就近转发模式

RegionId.description_en: The ID of the region to which the Express Connect Router (ECR) belongs

Message.description_en: The message returned for the operation

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:
True: The call was successful.
False: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。取值：
True：成功。
False：失败
